name: Barbeque Nation
src: Barbeque Nation "Nutritive value of served food items" (barbequenation.com/documents/nutrition-information.pdf, effective 30 August 2025), mostly per 100 g as served from the buffet; also UBQ delivery dishes and monthly festival dishes. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. No allergens: the list has no sesame. No beef or pork; mutton is goat. Dishes the menu lists under VEGETARIAN are marked vegetarian. Left out 11 cocktails, 27 meals/mini meals/platters, 50 repeated rows (the NEW version kept), and 43 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros, mostly the soya chaap dishes and the chicken tangdi (drumstick) dishes, whose calories run 60-80% above their macros.
